answer: Each agent can earn economic weight only by posting a bond that is locked for a fixed period and forfeited if the agent double-spends or violates a signed settlement rule. Splitting one identity into many does not multiply influence: every new identity needs another funded bond, while rewards accrue only to bonded capital. An attacker must therefore immobilize real assets for each Sybil and risk losing them, making a glacier of cheap disposable accounts costly to sustain. Even at the zenith of a campaign, they cannot wander past the weight their capital secures.
